answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 782 Country: MU Title: Is it permissible for a muslim to donate blood under any conditions? Question: Assalamualaikum Is it permissible for a muslim to donate blood under any conditions? Jazakumullah khair Answer ID: 782 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 296/L) There is a provision of using blood in a state of emergency in order to save a life. And, in this situation when taking blood is allowed then donating will also be allowed: لان الشیئ اذا ثبت ثبت بجمیع لوازمہ (منتخبات نظام الفتاوی، ج 1، ص 375، وجواھر الفقہ ج 2، ص 37، 38) But it will not be allowed to sell it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
